cve_summary: ImageMagick before 6.9.9-24 and 7.x before 7.0.7-12 has a use-after-free in Magick::Image::read in Magick++/lib/Image.cpp.
docstring:
Summary: This function reads an image into the Magick::Image object, ensuring that only a single image frame is processed.

Parameters:
- image (MagickCore::Image *): Pointer to the image to be read.
- exceptionInfo (MagickCore::ExceptionInfo *): Pointer to the exception information structure.

Returns: None

Logic: The function first checks if the provided image pointer is valid and if it has a subsequent frame. If so, it destroys any additional frames to ensure only one frame is retained. It then replaces the current image with the new one. If the exception severity is undefined and the image is null, it destroys the exception info and handles the no-image condition. If the image is not null, it throws an exception based on the image's exception information.
